props.name: as
props.description: The element or component this component should render as. Can be overwritten by `asChild`.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Change the default rendered element for the one passed as a child, merging their props and behavior.

Use this when you need a component to render through a child element while
keeping the primitive's props and behavior.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Whether or not an accordion item is disabled from user interaction.
When `true`, prevents the user from interacting with the item.

props.name: unmountOnHide
props.description: When `true`, the element will be unmounted on closed state.

props.name: value
props.description: A string value for the accordion item. All items within an accordion should use a unique value.
